sources.title: Magnum Research Desert Eagle Owner's Manual (DE-Manual.pdf), specifications tables
Kahr Firearms Group Product Catalog, 12th Edition 2026 (Magnum Research BFR specification tables)

weapons.name: Desert Eagle .429 DE Semi-auto Pistol
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer owner's manual, Mark XIX specifications table, row 'Polygonal Rifling (Right Hand Twist)', column '.429 DE': '429 DE: 1 in 18'. A separate specification line states 'Rifling Type: R.H. 6-Rib polygonal barrel'. States the .429 DE barrel has a right-hand twist of 1 turn in 18 inches = 457.2 mm, 6 ribs. The corpus lead (457.0 mm) is close but is not the source; the manufacturer figure 457.2 mm is used.

weapons.name: BFR .454 Casull Revolver
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer catalogue, 'BFR SHORT CYLINDER MODELS' specification table. Column order of the model row is 'BFR357MAG | BFR44MAG | BFR454C | BFR480-475 | BFR500JRH | BFR500LB', the caliber row is '.357 Magnum | .44 Magnum | .454 Casull | .480/.475 Linebaugh | .500 JRH | .500 Linebaugh', and the 'Twist Rate' row is '16 | 26 | 16 | 15 | 15 | 15'. The .454 Casull column therefore states a twist of 1 turn in 16 inches = 406.4 mm. Groove count is not stated in the table.
